title: Repair Cafés: origin in Amsterdam, how they work, and their spread

sources.title: As a place to fix, mend, and connect, repair cafes battle loneliness as well as waste (2025-02-13)

facts.text: The first repair café opened in Amsterdam in 2009.
Martine Postma founded the Repair Café movement in the Netherlands.
At repair cafés, skilled volunteers fix items free of charge, and visitors donate what they can afford.
Items commonly repaired include knives, scissors, garden tools, furniture, wobbly chairs and musical instruments.
The aim is to make everyday items last longer so that they do not end up in the bin.
More than 3,500 repair cafés operate in 40 countries.
Organizers say repair cafés are as much about community and meeting people as about fixing things.
